# Candidate crystals
- Crystal-K3: inorganic scintillator, high light yield, fast decay.
- Crystal-K1: inorganic scintillator, medium light yield.
- Crystal-K2: inorganic scintillator, mature growth process, lower light yield.
All three are available in the required sizes from at least one vendor.

# Earlier simulation summary (2025, nominal 5 cm thickness)
Energy resolution at 662 keV (FWHM): Crystal-K3 2.9%, Crystal-K1 4.5%, Crystal-K2 8.5%.
Thickness dependence was weak in the 3-8 cm range.

# Meeting notes 2026-02-11
Attendees discussed the shielding upgrade (lead + copper, complete) and the schedule for commissioning in Q3. Action: finalise the crystal choice this quarter.

# Radiopurity assay campaign, Q1 2026
Sample crystals of each candidate were counted for 30 days in the underground HPGe station.
Intrinsic background of the crystal, 100-3000 keV (counts/kg/day):
- Crystal-K3: 2.0 +- 0.2   (dominated by internal contamination of the crystal itself)
- Crystal-K1: 0.30 +- 0.05
- Crystal-K2: 0.10 +- 0.03
Facility background budget for the spectrometer crystal: 0.5 counts/kg/day.
Contact: radiopurity working group.

# Shielding status
The 20 cm lead + 5 cm OFHC copper castle is installed. Radon purge with boil-off nitrogen is operational.

# DAQ readout plan
The PMT signal is digitised at 250 MS/s with 14-bit ADCs. Firmware supports pulse-shape discrimination. No change is needed for any crystal candidate.

# Schedule
Q2: crystal procurement. Q3: assembly and commissioning. Q4: first assays.

content.text: K3 is excluded. K1 qualifies (0.30). Simulate K1 across thicknesses.
Minimum is near 5 cm; check neighbors.

input.justification: Crystal-K3 has the best resolution (2.9% in the 2025 simulation) but its intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day is 4 times the 0.5 hard limit, so it is excluded. Crystal-K1 and Crystal-K2 both meet the limit. K1 has much better resolution than K2 (about 4.5% against 8.5% in the 2025 summary). I scanned K1 from 2 to 8 cm. The best values were 4.40% at 6 cm and 4.43% at 5 cm. Resolution was worse at 7 cm (4.87%) and 8 cm (5.53%), and at 2-4 cm (4.6-5.1%). The 5 cm and 6 cm results differ by only 0.03 points, so the choice between them is marginal. I did not simulate K2 at any thickness in this session.

K1 measured 0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day in the Q1 2026 assay. K3 measured 2.0 and fails.
